samples.question: Inside the small pale inset is one connected navy trace with a red start cap and eight station dots. Follow the trace from the red cap in its connected order. At each station, lift its attached short tick and project the tick into the next column of one common vertical stencil, preserving whether it lies on the clockwise or counterclockwise side of the directed trace. Read the eight projected columns as the declared code: A) WAVE = ++--++--; B) FORK = +--++---. Which symbol appears? Ignore the pale frame and every mark outside the inset. Answer A or B.
